# NotificationService

NotificationService programmatic API.

## Identity

- Class: `NotificationService`
- Kind: root-provided Angular service
- Import from: `@arcwell/ui`
- [Service source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/feedback/notification.service.ts)

## Integration decisions

- Inject the service with Angular `inject(NotificationService)` or constructor injection.
- Read the method signatures and related types below before building configuration objects or handling returned references.
- Subscribe to lifecycle observables exposed by returned references when the application needs completion, action, or dismissal results. Clean up caller-owned subscriptions normally.
- Use the linked Storybook examples as executable recipes; their Actions entries show real service callbacks.
- Do not invent component inputs for a service or assume that component output observers capture programmatic service events.

## Related configuration, reference and provider APIs

```ts
export type NotificationPosition =
  | "top-left"
  | "top-center"
  | "top-right"
  | "bottom-left"
  | "bottom-center"
  | "bottom-right";

export interface NotificationOptions {
  id?: string;
  heading?: string;
  tone?: ComponentTone;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  variant?: "soft" | "outline" | "solid";
  customBackground?: string;
  customColor?: string;
  customBorder?: string;
  styleTokens?: Record<string, string>;
  position?: NotificationPosition;
  duration?: number;
  icon?: string;
  showIcon?: boolean;
  dismissible?: boolean;
  dismissLabel?: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  closeOnAction?: boolean;
  pauseOnHover?: boolean;
  showProgress?: boolean;
  live?: "polite" | "assertive" | "off";
  appearance?: ComponentAppearance;
}

export interface NotificationDefaults {
  maxVisible: number;
  duration: number;
  position: NotificationPosition;
  gap: string;
  offset: string;
}

export function provideNotifications( defaults: Partial<NotificationDefaults>, ): Provider;

export class NotificationRef {
  readonly afterDismissed: import("rxjs").Observable<NoticeDismissReason | "programmatic" | "overflow">;
  readonly onAction: import("rxjs").Observable<void>;
  dismiss(): void;
  finish( reason: NoticeDismissReason | "programmatic" | "overflow", ): void;
  notifyAction(): void;
}
```
